{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts undershoot prices during upticks, especially with positive sentiment",
    "When prices are declining, model predictions are too low and lag behind actual declines",
    "Positive sentiment amplifies the forecast-actual divergence in upward movements",
    "Mean reversion bias exists where forecasts move too slowly relative to price corrections",
    "Sentiment turning positive causes immediate price momentum that models delay",
    "Under volatile conditions, forecasts become compressed relative to true price ranges",
    "When prices hit local minima, model projections remain above reality for several days"
] }
